name: Lor'danel
summary: Lor'danel is a quiet night elf settlement nestled in the far northern reaches of Darkshore. Unlike the shadowy, storm-grey gloom that covers much of the coast, this coastal haven is framed by vibrant green trees and nourished by a sacred moonwell. Connected directly to Rut'theran Village and the broader Kaldorei lands by hippogryph routes, it stands as a peaceful outpost of Darnassus.

sections.title: A Verdant Outpost on the Foggy Coast
sections.body: Situated at the northern edge of Darkshore, Lor'danel offers an abrupt and welcoming contrast to the somber coastline to the south. Where the rest of Darkshore lies draped in coastal gloom and mist-drenched grey beaches, the earth and flora surrounding Lor'danel flourish in bright, verdant greens. The settlement serves as an essential vantage along the sea, featuring an inn for wayfarers, a moonwell blessed by Elune, and a well-traveled flight roost connecting mainland Darkshore directly to Rut'theran Village and the world tree Teldrassil above.

sections.title: Sentinels of the Shore
sections.body: Though Lor'danel borders the open sea, it lacks maritime piers or heavy harbor works, relying instead on vigilant sentinels, glaive throwers, and roosting hippogryphs for its safety and transit. Darnassian huntresses and Sentinels patrol its perimeter, monitoring the rugged coastline for any threats drifting southward from the open waters or emerging from the troubled wilderness of northern Kalimdor.

faq.answer: Lor'danel is located on the northern coast of Darkshore, resting along the seaside just south across the water from Teldrassil.

faq.q: Why does Lor'danel look different from the rest of Darkshore?
faq.answer: While most of Darkshore is choked with perpetual sea haze, grey sands, and ancient gnarled forests, the grove around Lor'danel remains rich, vibrant, and lushly green, sheltered beneath sacred boughs and cared for around a dedicated moonwell.

faq.q: Does Lor'danel have a dock for ships?
aliases: is there a boat in lordanel
faq.answer: No. Despite being nestled on the shoreline, Lor'danel has no harbor or docks. Instead, all travel across the sea to Rut'theran Village and other outposts is conducted through its hippogryph roost.
The settlement is protected by Darnassian Sentinels, vigilant protectors, archers, and heavy glaive throwers stationed to repel coastal beasts or hostile intruders.

angles.text: For night elves traversing the coast of Darkshore, Lor'danel is a familiar refuge, maintaining direct hippogryph connections back to Rut'theran Village beneath Teldrassil.
The moonwell resting within Lor'danel offers druids and followers of the Cenarion Circle a serene sanctuary to replenish their spirits and commune with nature.
